asset_label: interior industrial machine (rotating equipment, 15 kW and above) with a broadband RMS vibration-velocity reading supplied as metadata
source_note: ISO 20816-3:2022 vibration severity zones, broadband RMS velocity 10-1000 Hz (2-1000 Hz below 600 rpm). Zone boundaries copied from docs/research/10_multisensor_scope.md section 2.1 [23], whose source is a vendor glossary reproducing the standard (https://vibromera.eu/glossary/iso-20816-3/) and is tagged [PUBLIC, secondary]: verify against the ISO text before customer use. Group 2 = machines 15-300 kW, Group 1 = machines above 300 kW; 'rigid' and 'flexible' are the support types. Zone texts quoted from the note: Zone C 'Not suitable for continuous long-term operation'; Zone D 'Vibration severe enough to cause damage'. Unified mapping is the team's own [team-proposed, validate]: A S0 record, B S1 monitor, C S2 schedule, D S3 prioritize. The image grader can only apply these rows when rms_velocity_mm_s, machine group (kW class) and support type are passed as metadata (open question R10 section 9 item 10); from a photograph alone every row needs a measurement it cannot make, so the grade is U with not_measurable, never S0.

RMS velocity (mm/s, 10-1000 Hz), machine group (kW class) or support type not supplied in the metadata: no zone can be assigned from the image; grade U with not_measurable (never S0) and request the reading.

unified_note: Zone D with visible looseness, cracked foundations or a failed guard maps to S4 (escalate). Visible defects in the photograph (oil leaks, corrosion, missing guards, damaged couplings) are described in the justification but do not change the zone: the zone is a measurement result, not a visual grade.
measurement_note: Metadata keys the grader looks for: rms_velocity_mm_s, machine_group (1 or 2) or rated_kw, support_type (rigid or flexible), speed_rpm (below 600 rpm the band is 2-1000 Hz).

flags.not_measurable: set whenever the RMS velocity or the machine class is missing
